headline: Bitcoin is back around $61,000 on Monday in Bangkok after a weekend drop to about $55,100, with fear still extreme and a short US holiday week of inflation data, Fed rate-hike bets and a big options expiry ahead.

market.asOf: Read about 04:30 UTC Mon 23 Nov (11:30 Bangkok) from the CoinMarketCap homepage. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 11 out of 100, "Extreme Fear", on the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index (the page shows no update time); CoinMarketCap's own Fear and Greed Index showed 9, "Extreme fear".

stories.title: Bitcoin climbs back to about $61,000 after its weekend drop
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped to about $55,100 over the weekend and has since climbed back to about $61,000. Funding rates for borrowed bets are below normal, and fear gauges are still at extremes. US stock futures rose on Sunday night after last week's tech selloff.
points: Bitcoin was about $61,143, up 2.98% in 24 hours, on CoinMarketCap at about 04:30 UTC Monday; KuCoin's daily report put the weekend low at about $55,100.
Liquidations (forced closing of borrowed bets) were about $132.8 million in 24 hours, mostly bets on lower prices, and funding rates were below normal, per CoinGlass.
Holders realized about $11.3 billion of losses over 7 days, per KuCoin's daily market report.
The alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 11 out of 100 and CoinMarketCap's index reads 9, both "Extreme Fear".
S&P 500 futures rose 0.76% and Nasdaq-100 futures 1.19% on Sunday evening, per Seeking Alpha.

sources.label: CoinMarketCap: live prices and Fear and Greed
KuCoin: crypto daily market report, 23 Nov
Seeking Alpha: stock futures Sunday evening

stories.title: Fund outflows and a crowded holiday week keep pressure on crypto
stories.summary: Money kept leaving US bitcoin funds last week. This short Thanksgiving week brings US inflation data on Wednesday, with traders widely expecting the Fed to raise rates in December, and a large monthly bitcoin options expiry on Friday.
points: About $1.25 billion left US spot bitcoin ETFs in the week to 20 Nov, including a record $541.1 million outflow from BlackRock's IBIT on 19 Nov, per CEO Economy.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had lost about $3.59 billion in November through 20 Nov, per CEO Economy.
October PCE inflation comes out Wed 25 Nov at 8:30am ET; core PCE is expected at 3.2% a year against 3.1% before, per Newsquawk.
CME FedWatch showed a 93.2% chance of a quarter-point December rate hike, down from above 99%, per KuCoin (23 Nov).
About $6.76 billion of bitcoin options (112,323 BTC) expire on Deribit on Fri 27 Nov at 08:00 UTC, per Cryptoticker using Deribit data from 21 Nov.

sources.label: CEO Economy: IBIT record outflow, week to 20 Nov
KuCoin: December hike odds drop to 93.2%

stories.title: Saylor hints at another Strategy bitcoin buy a week before its index removal
stories.summary: Strategy, the company that holds 850,849 bitcoin, may announce another purchase: chairman Michael Saylor posted "The dots aren't done", a hint he has used before purchases, but nothing is confirmed until the company files. At current prices its bitcoin is worth less than it paid, and it leaves the MSCI indexes after the 30 Nov close.
points: Strategy holds 850,849 BTC bought at an average of $75,452, per KuCoin.
That leaves a paper loss of about $12.6 billion, per KuCoin.
MSCI confirmed Strategy's removal from its indexes at the end of November, per Cointelegraph.
Strategy estimates index funds hold about 13 million of its shares; KuCoin valued them at about $1.49 billion at the 12 Nov close.

sources.label: KuCoin: Saylor signals new bitcoin buy

briefs.title: Kalshi faces a New York court hearing today
briefs.summary: Justice Melissa Crane hears the New York Attorney General's restraining-order request against Kalshi at 11:30am ET Mon 23 Nov; Kalshi says it could shut its exchange nationwide, which the AG's office says it does not seek, per The Block.

briefs.title: Chainflip hack bounty deadline is today
briefs.summary: The attacker has until 18:38 UTC on Mon 23 Nov to return 90% of about $12 million stolen and keep a 10% bounty, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Monad's first big team and investor unlock is Tuesday
briefs.summary: About 16.6 billion MON unlocks on Tue 24 Nov at the one-year cliff for team and investor tokens, per Coinranking, which puts it at about $324 million using CryptoRank; this desk's unlock data puts it nearer $206 million. See the unlock table for confidence.

briefs.title: Trump hosts a second memecoin dinner
briefs.summary: Donald Trump hosted the top TRUMP token holders on Sunday night; the token is down about 99% from its peak, and eight senators asked the White House for the guest list, per The Block.

briefs.title: Fusionist's ACE bridge drained after a $2 million exploit
briefs.summary: An attacker minted unbacked ACE and cashed out about $2 million, then traders emptied about $3.7 million of real ACE from the bridge, per The Block.

briefs.title: JPMorgan puts bitcoin's production cost near $86,000
briefs.summary: With bitcoin around $60,000, that gap puts pressure on higher-cost miners, per The Block.

briefs.title: Senate passes ban on prediction-market bets on war and death
briefs.summary: The Senate passed a bipartisan bill on 19 Nov banning prediction-market contracts on war, terrorism, assassination and death; it now goes to the House, per CoinDesk.

calendar.event: New York court hearing on Kalshi
calendar.note: The court hears the New York Attorney General's restraining-order request against Kalshi, per The Block.

calendar.event: New York Fed President John Williams speaks
calendar.note: The only Fed speaker on this week's calendars, per FXEmpire.
Expected at 92.1 after 91.7 in October, per FXEmpire. Dell, HP and Workday report earnings after the close.

calendar.event: US PCE inflation (Oct), Q3 GDP (updated estimate), durable goods and jobless claims
calendar.note: Core PCE is expected at 3.2% a year (prior 3.1%), per Newsquawk. Q3 GDP is expected at 3.5% after 3.4%, durable goods at 0.5% after 1.9%, and weekly jobless claims at 201K after 203K, per FXEmpire.
Per FXEmpire. New home sales come out earlier the same day at 10:00am ET (22:00 Bangkok); 649K is expected after 676K, per FXEmpire.
US stock and bond markets are closed; on Friday 27 Nov stocks close early at 1:00pm ET (01:00 Sat Bangkok).

calendar.event: Monthly bitcoin options expiry on Deribit
calendar.note: About $6.76 billion of bitcoin options (112,323 BTC) expire, with the "max pain" level at $73,000, per Cryptoticker using Deribit data from 21 Nov.

calendar.event: Strategy (MSTR) leaves MSCI indexes at the close
calendar.note: Removal takes effect after the 30 Nov close; Strategy estimates index funds hold about 13 million of its shares, which KuCoin valued at about $1.49 billion at the 12 Nov close.
Comes out before the Fed's 9 Dec decision, per the BLS schedule.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Decision Wed 9 Dec at 2:00pm ET, press conference 2:30pm ET. Fed officials go quiet on policy from Sat 28 Nov. CME FedWatch showed a 93.2% chance of a quarter-point hike, per KuCoin (23 Nov).
